source_read: https://mowglistreetfood.com/menus/food/ (fresh GET 2026-10-08 after an RFC 9309 robots check, sha256 4065b34b1b602f1c0631634c6fbdc20b9bacb295a0c2f025deae72a9c1d6c2c7) and its linked https://mowglistreetfood.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Mowgli-Mv35_Allergen-Matrix_Brighton_v3.pdf (sha256 7e0f82c34a50e06732fe157cd5e09842842276438009985ea7eeebc17ac873f6; 2 pages, page 1 = food, page 2 = drinks, not read)
methods: Three independent readings agree on all 46 published dishes: (1) each dish card's own data-allergens list on the menu page (what the page's Allergens filter uses; this is the published list); (2) the matrix PDF's text layer (FontAwesome tick glyphs reported by pdftotext -bbox-layout, assigned to dish rows by height and to the 14 allergen columns by cell edges); (3) pixel sampling of all 51 rows x 14 columns = 714 cells of the 100 dpi render of matrix page 1 (ink in the cell vs a tick found by the text layer): 0 cells differ, 105 ticks. The rendered matrix page was also looked at by eye (all rows). The set of allergens per dish is identical between the page and the matrix for all 46 dishes (the matrix's '(tick) Optional ingredient' ticks, 8 on published dishes: Rainbow Frankie Wrap milk; Mowgli Chicken Salad wheat; Mowgli Tenderstem Salad wheat and milk; the four ice cream cones' wheat (cone), count as present, exactly as the page lists them).
notes: Published: 46 of 46 dishes now have allergens.csv rows (page list; cereal and tree-nut kinds from the matrix where it names the dish exactly: 18 rows get a kind, e.g. wheat, barley, oats, almond). Seven page dishes are named differently in the matrix and are cross-checked on the set of allergens only (ALIAS in mowgli.py): Maa's Lamb Chops (matrix '... & Fries'), Garlic Butter Paratha (matrix 'Garlic & Coriander Paratha'), and the five Kids Menu dishes (the matrix's MINI MOWGLI rows, e.g. 'Mowgli Paneer & Rice'; 'Kids Brownie'); they carry no kinds. Matrix rows with no dish on the food page: Vegan Yoghurt Chat Bombs, Vegan Diwali Cauliflower, Vegan Roti Breads, Vegan Mini Poppadoms, Enka's Fish & Chips (Brighton Exclusive), plus the whole drinks page. The 4 kids ice cream cones printed twice on the page agree exactly. may_contain_published changed yes -> no: neither the page nor the matrix gives any per-dish may-contain (the matrix header only says suppliers may have added warnings), so the app now says the guide does not say what may be present in traces. The matrix is the Brighton restaurant's: it is the matrix the chain's own menu page links, and the page's own list agrees dish by dish. Two medium audit flags logged as ok in data/audit/reviewed/mowgli.csv (Tamarind is not tamari; a sorbet cone has no milk). I tried to drive the page's allergen filter in Chromium as a fourth check; it did not respond to scripted clicks (not an app issue), so it was not used. Re-checked 2026-10-09 by a second helper: mowgli.py re-run on the same page and matrix files reproduces data/source/mowgli byte for byte; the data-allergens of all 50 dish cards (46 distinct dishes, read from the DOM in Chromium, not by the script's regex) equal allergens.csv for every dish; all 46 published rows (14 allergens, cereal and nut words, optional ticks counted as present) compared by eye against the matrix page rendered at 130 dpi: 0 differences; every dish's description on the page was read against its row (policy 3): no contradiction (Gunpowder Chicken and Sticky Chicken are fried in a 'chickpea batter', which is why neither marks gluten; Onion Bhajis are 'gram flour'). check_chain.py mowgli --fail-on-high: 0 errors, 0 flags.
